why: A write fails with SQLITE_CORRUPT mid-session at a 212-day streak. A rollover against damaged rows could burn a freeze or break a streak from corruption rather than behaviour, and freeze consumption is irreversible.

cases.why: The 212-day streak with five missed days and two freezes: nothing is spent, nothing is broken.
Even one missed day and one freeze: still nothing.
The same input on a healthy DB does roll over, so the precondition is not a permanent refusal.
